tool.name: MetaCoAG
tool.description: metagenomic contig binning via connectivity information
tool.command:
#import re
mkdir outputs &&
#set $basename = re.sub('[^\w\-_\.]', '_', $assembler.contigs.element_identifier)
ln -s '$assembler.contigs' '${basename}.fasta' && ln -s '$assembler.abundance' '${basename}.tsv' &&
#if $assembler.is_select == 'spades': ln -s '$assembler.paths' '${basename}.paths' && #end if
#if $assembler.is_select == 'flye': ln -s '$assembler.paths' '${basename}_path.tsv' && #end if
#if $assembler.is_select == 'megahit': agtools fastg2gfa -g '$assembler.graph' -k ${k} -o '${basename}.gfa' && #else ln -s '$assembler.graph' '${basename}.gfa' && #end if
#if $marker_file.is_select == 'yes': ln -s '$marker_file.hmm' 'marker.hmm' && #end if
metacoag --assembler '$assembler.is_select' --graph '${basename}.gfa' --contigs '${basename}.fasta' --abundance '${basename}.tsv' #if $assembler.is_select == 'spades': --paths '${basename}.paths' #end if #if $assembler.is_select == 'flye': --paths '${basename}_path.tsv' #end if #if $marker_file.is_select == 'yes': --hmm 'marker.hmm' ${n_mg} #end if --output 'outputs' --min_length ${min_length} --p_intra ${p_intra} --p_inter ${p_inter} --d_limit ${d_limit} --depth ${depth} $no_cut_tc --mg_threshold ${mg_threshold} --bin_mg_threshold ${bin_mg_threshold} --min_bin_size ${min_bin_size} --delimiter '$delimiter' --nthreads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4}"
&&
mv '${basename}.fasta.frag.faa' '$faa_file' && mv '${basename}.fasta.frag.ffn' '$ffn_file' && mv '${basename}.fasta.frag.gff' '$gff_file' && mv '${basename}.fasta.hmmout' '$hmmout_file'

tool.help:
**What is this tool**
MetaCoAG is a metagenomic contig binning tool that makes use of the connectivity information found in assembly graphs, apart from the composition and coverage information. MetaCoAG makes use of single-copy marker genes along with a graph matching technique and a label propagation technique to bin contigs.
**Input**
For all assemblers:
- Assembly graph file (GFA/TXT for Spades/Flye/Custom and FASTG for MEGAHIT [FASTG file will be convert to GFA via utility in the wrapper]) - Contigs in FASTA format - Abundance (from for example CheckM)
Assembler specific file:
- For Spades the contigs.path file is required - For Flye the assembly_info.txt file is required
**Outputs**
- List with all bins in FASTA format - List with to low bins in FASTA format - A tabular file which show where each contig is binned - FragScan output (FFN, FAA and GFF file) - Hmmsearch output
